question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

Killing of one person by another
solution: The correct answer is** "Homicide."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Homicide"** refers to the killing of one person by another. (एक व्‍यक्ति द्वारा दूसरे की ग़ैर-क़ानूनी हत्‍या; हत्‍या) • **Example**: *He was convicted of **homicide**__.* • The word is derived from the Latin words **homo **(meaning human) and **caedere** (meaning to cut or kill). • The term **homicide** is often used interchangeably with the term **murder**, but the two words have different legal definitions. • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Fratricide** refers specifically to the killing of one's own brother. (अपने ही भाई की हत्या) • **Genocide** refers to the intentional killing of a large group of people, typically based on their ethnicity or nationality. (विशेष प्रजाति, धर्म आदि के लोगों की सामूहिक हत्‍या; नरसंहार) • **Filicide** refers to the killing of one's own child. (अपने ही बच्चे की हत्या) 41:Tc38, The correct answer is** "relief to be away."**
